description.content: Hello and welcome, Wild Heart / Yabani this series has 153 episodes with English subtitles. Wild Heart is a Turkish series this story follows a young man named Yaman Ali as the story progresses he'll soon realize that sometimes small mishaps led to great coincidences. He was kidnapped at a local park when he was 4 years old once his mother found out she was very devastated by all this she has been relentlessly trying to find Yaman Ali ever since. Yaman Ali was forced to survive living on the streets for 17 years he was left to defend for himself and find food for himself, Yaman Ali loves his street family they are Cesur, Asi, and Umut, Yaman has been working relentlessly focusing on getting a life-changing treatment for his close friend Umut who is like family to him this poor boy is in a wheelchair with a disability he can’t walk on his own. But one night something unexpectedly changes for Yaman Ali as he suddenly sees Rüya a very beautiful young woman, and Yaman Ali sees her struggling with her very drunk boyfriend Alaz she feels really embarrassed about everything that is currently happing then Yaman Ali decides to knocks out Alaz and puts him into their car then Yaman starts walking away Ruya gets out the car quickly and politely asks Yaman Ali if he can drive them both back home because Rüya can't legally drive a car yet? so Yaman agrees and this is when everything starts to slowly change for Yaman Ali, one day Yaman suddenly meets with a wealthy family at a hospital, the Soysalans, leading him toward his lost past. But what Yaman does not realize yet is that this wealthy family he just met is actually his real family and Nesilan who is his real mother she doesn’t know yet but Yaman is her long lost son as she slowly starts get to know Yaman a man with a wild heart who is smart yet poor but it doesn’t stop him from being the man he is, he has a good heart but has a wild side also Yaman has a lot of changes coming to his current life real question is will he accept these big changes and his mother is wondering if he'll stay with his real family and be a big brother for his brother and sisters but he has a lot of adjusting to do but what will Yaman do when he finds the people who are responsible for his kidnapping only time will tell?
